You are provided with solid M.
Do the following tests on solid M, recording all of your observations at each stage.
tests on solid M
Add about 15 cm3 of distilled water to the boiling tube containing solid M. Stopper the boiling tube and
shake the mixture to dissolve solid M and form solution M. Divide solution M into five approximately
equal portions in five test‑tubes.
